verdict.rationale: Oneleet's Fieldwork page says its AI agents collect, validate, and package evidence 'on your schedule', which implies user-defined recurring evidence-collection workflows, but no documentation describes how to configure that schedule. The fixed daily repository scan is a recurring job the platform runs itself, not one the user schedules, so it only supports the story in a limited way. Missing for 10: documented user-configurable scheduling (cron, intervals, triggers), the ability to schedule arbitrary workflows beyond evidence collection, API/MCP access to create schedules, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Fieldwork’s AI agents collect, validate, and package the evidence – across your enterprise systems, on your schedule.
Oneleet scans the target branch of each repository once a day, and you can start a scan manually at any time with New scan.
